description: Asks to put an earlier version of a project's browser extension back in the stores it is live in, for example when the newest version broke something. Without to_version it goes back to the version that was live before the current one; without store it goes back in every store. The stores see it as a new version and may review it again. Nothing happens until you approve it in CodeGene: the answer gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes. Send the person that link; you cannot approve it. Then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

store.description: Only this store, as get_extension_store_status names it.

to_version.description: The version to go back to, as get_extension_store_status lists it.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: roll_back_extension
title: Put an earlier extension version back in the stores
